Panchang.lead: Tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana and the day's muhurat windows for {city}, worked out from where the Sun and Moon actually are.

Panchang.metaDescriptionToday: Today's Vedic almanac: tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana and the day's muhurat windows. Open any date from {minYear} to {maxYear}.
Panchang.metaDescriptionDay: Panchang for {date} in {city}: tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana, sunrise, sunset, Rahu Kaal and Abhijit Muhurat.
Panchang.metaDescriptionMonth: Day-by-day Panchang for {month} in {city}: tithi and nakshatra at sunrise, sunrise and sunset times.
Panchang.eclipseSun: Solar eclipse (Surya Grahan) on this day, greatest at {time}.
Panchang.eclipseMoon: Lunar eclipse (Chandra Grahan) on this day, greatest at {time}.
Panchang.pickerHint: Birthdays, anniversaries, a date you are planning for. Pick the city closest to you, because sunrise decides the day's tithi.
Panchang.method: These values are calculated for {city} from the positions of the Sun and Moon, using the Lahiri ayanamsa. The tithi, nakshatra, yoga and karana shown are the ones running at sunrise, as printed almanacs do. We check the calculation against a second astronomy engine and against NASA's published eclipse dates for {minYear} to {maxYear}.
Panchang.methodCaveat: Regional almanacs follow their own traditions and can differ by a day for some festivals. Panchang is a traditional calendar offered for guidance. It is not a prediction or a guarantee.
